intended_operation.question: How long do I have to request a refund?
intended_operation.draft: Refund requests must be submitted within 14 days of purchase.

human_sequence: Review the new public fixture and consent as Wallet B on Studionet.
Approve this one fresh request in MetaMask.
Immediately change the account connected to the ReplyCheck site to Wallet A (0x29b8b7d7cbf534eba01e56919de19d79d1509360), retaining Studionet.
Say done promptly. Do not approve another transaction or resubmit this one.
verification_plan: Capture the first post-switch UI and public recovery export before writing reports.
Run the prebuilt read-only capture helper immediately; verify B sender, exact fixture/calldata and pending receipt.
Only if an independent pending receipt is observed with A shown in the app can the pending-account test be counted; otherwise keep that case unexercised.
Use the same hash for any subsequent network check and final reconciliation. Require exactly one new review, preserved full prior state, and no resubmission.
